categories.archiveHelp: Archiving hides the category from new issues and the grid. Issued credentials and their scans stay on record.
categories.archived: Category archived. Its credentials and scan history stay.
categories.codeHelp: Capitals, digits and hyphens, up to 16 characters, such as ALL-ACCESS.
categories.empty: No credential categories yet. Define who goes where, starting with a category such as CREW.
categories.issuedSummary: {count, plural, =0 {No live credentials in this category.} one {# live credential in this category.} other {# live credentials in this category.}}
categories.meta: {project} · {count, plural, =0 {no live credentials} one {# live credential} other {# live credentials}}
categories.name: Name
categories.categoryKindHelp: A parking pass is a category of kind Parking, tied to parking zones on the access grid.

collab.noAttachments: No files attached yet. Upload a photo or document that belongs with this record.
collab.noComments: No comments yet. Start the discussion about this record here.
collab.scanning: Being checked for viruses; download opens once the check passes.
collab.uploaded: File uploaded. It can be downloaded once the virus check passes.

common.chooseProject: Choose a project first. Credentials, zones and the access grid belong to one project.
common.errorSentence: This page could not load. Try again; if it keeps failing, send the reference to your administrator.
common.noProjects: There are no projects you can open yet. Create a project, then come back to set up credentials.
common.recordMissing: This record does not exist or you cannot open it. Return to the list to pick another.
common.timeZoneHelp: Times are in {zone}, the project's time zone.

errors.alertInput: Choose a code and write the announcement, then try again.
errors.categoryInput: Enter a code of capitals, digits and hyphens and a name, then try again.
errors.channelInput: Enter a channel number from 1 and a name, then try again.
errors.commentInput: Write a comment of up to 10,000 characters, then post it.
errors.confirmRevoke: Tick the box to confirm the revocation, then try again.
errors.conflict: That value is already used. Choose another and try again.
errors.dispatchInput: Choose a responder, then try again.
errors.encounterInput: Describe the patient without medical detail, then try again.
errors.fileInput: Choose a file to upload, then try again.
errors.fileNotReady: This file is not ready yet. Try again once its virus check passes.
errors.fileSize: Files can be up to 50 MB. Choose a smaller file.
errors.gridInput: Choose a category, a zone and an access level, then try again.
errors.incidentInput: Say what happened and choose a severity, then try again.
errors.invalid: Some values are out of range. Check the fields and try again.
errors.issueInput: Choose a category and a holder, then try again.
errors.mediaInput: Enter the stored file path, then try again.
errors.notFound: This record no longer exists or you cannot change it. Reload the page.
errors.occurredAt: Enter when it happened; it cannot be in the future.
errors.partyInput: Enter a role or description, then try again.
errors.reasonInput: Give a reason for the change, then try again.
errors.refused: The system refused this change. Check the record's state and try again.

rules.credential_engagement_project: The engagement belongs to another project. Choose an engagement on this project.
rules.credential_immutable: A credential keeps its holder, issuer, number and category. Revoke it and issue a new one instead.
rules.credential_revoked: This credential is revoked and stays revoked. Issue a new one.
rules.credential_self_issue: You cannot issue a credential to yourself. Ask another issuer.
rules.credential_unknown: No credential matches that number. Check the badge and try again.
rules.dispatch_id_taken: Another dispatch already uses this id.
rules.enumeration_domain: Choose a value from the list; it must come from the canon.
rules.incident_close_rpc: Close an incident with sign-off: use Close with sign-off.
rules.incident_closed: This incident is closed and cannot be relabeled.
rules.incident_device_time_future: The report time is later than now. Check the device clock.
rules.incident_id_taken: Another incident already uses this id.
rules.incident_media_id_taken: Another photo or video already uses this id.
rules.incident_party_id_taken: Another party already uses this id.
rules.incident_relabel_and_close: A critical incident cannot be relabeled and closed at once. Change the severity first, then close it.
rules.incident_signoff_rpc: Sign-off is recorded only when closing with sign-off.
rules.incident_state_conflict: Someone moved this incident first. Reload to see its current state.
rules.incident_transition_not_allowed: That move is not allowed from the incident's current state.
rules.medical_capability_required: Recording medical encounters needs the medical records permission. Ask an Owner.
rules.production_closed: This project's production is closed. New incidents cannot be filed on it.
rules.scan_device_time_future: The scan time is later than now. Check the device clock.
rules.scan_id_taken: Another scan already uses this id.
rules.scan_offline_needs_time: An offline decision needs the time it was made.
rules.sod_approval_requester: The reporter of a critical incident cannot sign off its closure. Ask another eligible person.
rules.transition_reason_required: Give a reason for the change, then try again.
rules.scan_intake_resolved: This scan was already resolved. Reload the page.
rules.scan_intake_dismiss_note: Say why the scan is dismissed.
rules.credential_engagement_holder: A badge issued under an engagement goes to the person the engagement names.
rules.credential_engagement_closed: That engagement is Complete or Canceled, so it takes no new badges.
rules.credential_category_kind_in_use: This category keeps its kind while open allocations name it. Withdraw or finish them first.
rules.person_not_on_project: That person is neither a member nor engaged on this project. Choose someone from the list.
rules.credential_photo_batch_size: Ask for the photos of 1 to 100 credentials at a time.
rules.credential_photo_path: That photo is not in the holder's own folder. Upload it again from Gateway.
rules.credential_photo_no_credential: The holder no longer holds a live credential here, so the organization takes no photo from them.
rules.credential_photo_not_issuer: Only someone who issues this person's credentials can remove their badge photo.
rules.credential_photo_scanning: This photo is still being scanned. Remove it once the scan finishes, in a few minutes.
rules.credential_photo_unscanned: The virus scan could not clear this photo, so only the holder can delete it. Ask them to replace or remove it in Gateway.
rules.credential_training_incomplete: This person has not completed the training or certifications this category requires. Record them first, then issue.
rules.credential_duplicate: This person already holds a live badge of this category for an overlapping window. Revoke the earlier badge first, or change the window.
rules.scan_not_denied: Only a denied entry scan can be overridden. The database may have let this person in after all.
rules.scan_override_revoked: A revoked badge is never let in. Issue a new badge instead.
rules.scan_override_stale: This denial is more than 15 minutes old. Scan the badge again.
rules.scan_override_self: Nobody overrides a denial of their own badge. Ask another supervisor.
rules.scan_override_reason: Say why you are letting this person in, in up to 300 characters.
rules.scan_override_rpc: Overrides are recorded with the Override control only.

errors.scanInput: Choose a zone and type a credential number, then try again.
errors.signoffInput: Write a sign-off note, then close the incident.
errors.unexpected: The change could not be saved. Try again in a moment.
errors.window: Check the dates: the end must come after the start.
errors.dismissInput: Say why the scan is dismissed, then try again.
errors.emergencyCodeInput: Enter a label, the emergency it announces and a position from 1, then try again.
errors.confirmRemovePhoto: Check the box to confirm you want to remove the photo.

grid.empty: No zone access granted yet. Grant a category entry to a zone to start the grid.
grid.explain: Each row lets one category enter one zone at a canon access level during a window. Scans are decided from this grid by the database.
grid.matrixHelp: Toggling a cell grants {level} for the next 30 days or withdraws the pair. Change levels and windows in the Spreadsheet view.
grid.needsCategories: The access grid needs credential categories. Create one for this project first.
grid.needsZones: The access grid needs zones. Add zones to the project's venue in Places.
grid.tableAlternative: Show the grid as a table

issued.empty: No credentials issued yet. Issue badges to crew, vendors and guests.
issued.emptyFiltered: No credentials match these filters. Clear a filter or issue a new credential.
issued.holderHelp: You cannot issue a credential to yourself; another issuer does that.
issued.needsCategory: This project has no credential categories yet. Create one, then issue credentials in it.
issued.revokeConfirm: Revoke {number}. A revoked credential is denied at every zone and cannot be restored.
issued.scansHidden: You cannot read this project's scan log.
issued.validToHelp: Leave empty to keep it valid until revoked.

scans.decided: {number}{holder, select, none {} other { · {holder}}} at {zone}: {decision, select, Granted {access granted} other {access denied}}.
scans.deskHelp: Type the number printed on a badge to check it at a zone. The scan is logged and decided by the database.
scans.empty: No scans yet. Scans appear here as credentials are checked at zones in Compass or at the scan desk.
scans.emptyFiltered: No scans match these filters. Clear a filter to see every scan.

reasons.NotYetValid: the badge is not valid yet
reasons.NoZoneAccess: the badge has no access to this zone

scans.overrideBody: This entry scan was denied. Say why you are letting {name} in; the log keeps the denial and your reason.
scans.overrideReasonHelp: 1 to 300 characters, such as who escorted them.

intake.heading: Unresolved scans
intake.help: Codes a device could not match when it scanned them. Each waits here until someone binds it to the catalog or dismisses it. Nothing is matched automatically.
intake.loadError: We could not load the unresolved scans. Reload the page to try again.
intake.noteHelp: Required. For example: a test tag, or a code that belongs to another org.

photo.heading: Badge photo

stateHelp.Provided: The holder gave this photo; it prints on the badge.
stateHelp.Scanning: The holder gave a photo; it prints once the virus scan clears it, in a few minutes.
stateHelp.Refused: The photo the holder gave failed the virus scan or is gone. Ask them for another.
stateHelp.Profile: No badge photo yet, so the badge prints the holder's profile photo.
stateHelp.Requested: Asked for a photo; the holder has not given one yet.
stateHelp.Missing: No photo: the badge prints "No photo on file".

photo.copyLinkHelp: Send this link to the holder: they add their photo in Gateway, under Profile, Badge photos.
photo.removeConfirm: Remove {name}'s badge photo. Their badge prints without it until they give another.
photo.removeAfterScan: You can remove this photo once its scan finishes.
photo.notLive: A revoked or expired credential prints no photo.
